audit.why: Lane difficulty reads even-to-favored early with the flip at two items; text matches 54.07% WR and content layer.
Spikes (2, 6, first item, two-items flip) are present and consistent with content spikes[0..3].

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried no numbers; full-layer level chart said 'Skill' on all 7 rows while content win[] and the packet chart say Talon x6 then Malzahar.
audit.why: Nether Grasp is 140/110/80s and Malefic Visions 11s rank 1 — those numbers are the trade windows. Chart layers must agree.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with real numbers; full sides aligned to content/packet with matching whys.

audit.why: Kit flag marks Malefic Visions as 'execute', but Riot's text describes spread-on-kill plus mana refund, not a threshold execute. Trusting the description; did not write the missing-interaction headline as an execute threat.

edits.before: W the wave and his chest — the return pass is the damage; stand where the boomerang's geometry doubles.
edits.after: No dash, no shield stacked yet — W his chest on contact and walk him down; the return pass is the damage.

edits.before: Q-leap trades begin: W-Q-auto procs the bleed at 2 and most mids don't budget for it.
edits.after: Q-leap trades open: W-Q-auto procs the bleed at 2, more burst than his Void Shift soaks.

edits.before: Full kit: the parkour opens — every wall on mid's border is now a gank route or an exit visa.
edits.after: Full kit: E over any wall dodges his Q silence angle — you pick the trade and you pick the exit.

edits.before: Bleed-string the contacts: W both passes, Q the gap, auto the third stack. The lane bleeds rent.
edits.after: Bleed-string his 11s E windows: W both passes, Q the gap, auto the third stack — he can't trade back.

edits.before: Shadow Assault online — the roam game doubles and the all-in wraps targets in a blade carousel.
edits.after: Shadow Assault online — his 140s Nether Grasp is held for junglers, so your all-in still wins the duel.

edits.before: First item spike: the full string one-rotations squishies. Shove and parkour — side lanes owe you taxes.
edits.after: First item spike: the Dirk string one-rotates him when Nether Grasp is down. Track the 140s timer, then dive.

edits.before: Late Talon flanks from coordinates wards don't cover: R in, string the carry, blade-exit through the wall.
edits.after: Two items deep his point-click Nether Grasp plus Zhonya's ends your all-in — flank his carries, not him.

edits.before: - Malzahar Nether Grasp: matchup-defining — Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Assassin's Path for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Malzahar Nether Grasp: 140/110/80s and point-and-click — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up; the downtime is your whole window. - His E Malefic Visions runs 11s at rank 1 — trade in the gap right after he spends it on the wave.

edits.before: W on the contact, Q the gap, auto for the bleed, walk through the return — three stacks of rent he paid for one trade.
edits.after: Open W as he steps up to last-hit, Q the gap, auto the third Wound stack — the DoT ticks while you walk out through the return.

edits.before: Q-leaping into a held CC for style — Talon without the gap-closer is a roamer stuck in traffic.
edits.after: An uncrashed wave hands him free plates and time to ping — crash it first so the roam pays for itself.

notes: Kit derived flag calls Malefic Visions an 'execute'; Riot's own text describes spread-on-kill plus mana refund, not a threshold execute — trusted the description and did not add the _missing execute-threshold headline. Full-layer chart carried a blanket 'Skill' on all seven rows against content win[] Talon x6/Malzahar and the identical packet chart; aligned full to those with rewritten whys. Ratings on rows 0-3 and 6 changed to match verdicts (enum-exempt).
